presignature_policy.policy: one fresh single-use pre-signature per EpidSign

timed_scope.pre_signature_generation: one offline EpidAddPreSigs pre-signature; disclosed separately and excluded from T_DG
timed_scope.T_DG: one direct online EpidSign call consuming exactly one pre-signature
timed_scope.T_DV: one direct EpidVerify call on an already generated valid quote

measurement_notes: Raw average includes Python loop and callable overhead.
Corrected average subtracts a no-op callable-loop baseline.
Key generation is excluded unless explicitly represented by a timing symbol.

Di5Guise uses the design-level DAA formula. T_DG and T_DV come from direct Intel EPID EpidSign/EpidVerify calls in the native companion benchmark; no ordinary signature substitutes for DAA. T_DG uses random unlinkable basename and consumes one fresh EpidAddPreSigs item; offline pre-signature cost is reported separately in daa_implementation.

operations.note: One fresh Miller loop plus final pairing equality verification against a precomputed valid reference.
Implements the G1 exponentiation/scalar multiplication counted in the table.

operations.operation: Scalar multiplication in auxiliary group G_aux
